newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares inch lower, A shares rebound.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares inch lower, A shares rebound.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index closed slightly lower on Wednesday on speculative selling despite institutional support for several issues with good profits but A shares rebounded after a sharp drop on Tuesday, brokers said.
The B share index inched down 0.02 of a point to 88.85, with turnover rising to HK$18.70 million from HK$12.31 million on Tuesday.

Light speculative selling drove some counters sharply lower, dragging down the index, but market sentiment was helped by institutional demand for a handful of issues with strong earnings, traders said.
Television maker Huafa was the day's biggest loser on speculative selling, brokers said. It lost HK$0.09, or 5.33 percent, to HK$1.60, on volume of 15,000 shares.

Hainan Pearl River fell HK$0.08, or 4.04 percent, to HK$1.90, with only 1,300 shares changing hands. Dadonghai maintained its downward trend, slipping HK$0.02 to HK$1.27, on the largest volume of 1.28 million shares.
Great Ocean was the best performer, rising HK$0.14, or 7.69 percent, to HK$1.96, in thin trade of 18,000 shares.

Building materials producer Fangda was aided by institutional demand, brokers said. It rose HK$0.22 to HK$5.35, on volume of 516,000 shares. Gujing Distillery followed suit, firming HK$0.08 to HK$5.62. Guangdong Power lost early gains to end unchanged at HK$5.29 in the second most active trade of 1.20 million shares.

The A share market rebounded after a steep drop on Tuesday, brokers said. The A share index rose 11.22 points, or 3.11 percent, to 372.04, but turnover fell to 9.31 billion yuan from 11.81 billion yuan.
The composite index advanced 10.00 points, or 2.97 percent, to close at 346.54.
Brokers said that, despite the rally, investors adopted a wait-and-see stance following the market's recent bull run.

Anhui Hongxing Xuanzhi Paper Co Ltd listed 15.30 million A shares in Shenzhen on Wednesday and ended at 15.47 yuan per share against an offer price of 5.88 yuan per share in volume of 10.19 million shares.

Gujing Distillery soared 3.40 yuan, or 14.98 percent, to 26.10 yuan. Jinan Diesel Engine, listed in Shenzhen on Tuesday, tumbled 0.51 yuan, or 3.61 percent, to 13.60 yuan on Wednesday on profit-taking, brokers said.
